recipe.recipe_name: Savory Cheddar French Toast with Fresh Tomatoes
instructions: Dice the fresh tomatoes and grate or thinly slice the cheddar cheese.
In a shallow bowl, whisk together 4 eggs and 60 ml of whole milk until smooth.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Dip each slice of bread into the egg mixture for 5-10 seconds per side until well coated.
Place the coated bread slices in the hot skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes until golden brown on the bottom.
Flip the bread using a spatula, immediately top each slice with the cheddar cheese and diced tomatoes, then cover the pan with a lid for 2 minutes to melt the cheese while the bottom browns.
Remove from the pan using the spatula and serve warm immediately.
recipe.waste_reduction_notes: This recipe prioritizes items nearest to expiration: Whole Milk (expiring Sept 22), Eggs and Tomatoes (expiring Sept 23), and Cheddar Cheese (expiring Sept 24), preventing waste of perishable fridge staples.

evaluation.status_message: Recipe perfectly matches your fridge ingredients and cooking parameters!

instructions: Rinse 150g of rice under cold water. Combine with water in a medium pot, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low heat for 12-15 minutes until tender.
While rice cooks, dice 1-2 chicken breasts into bite-sized pieces and slice 2 tomatoes into small wedges. Beat 2 eggs in a small bowl.

Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add the diced chicken breast and stir-fry for 5-7 minutes until cooked through and lightly browned. Remove chicken and set aside.
Add another tablespoon of olive oil to the same pan. Pour in beaten eggs and scramble lightly for 1 minute until soft curds form.
Add the sliced tomatoes to the eggs and stir-fry for 2 minutes until softened and juicy.

Add the cooked rice and cooked chicken into the pan with the eggs and tomatoes. Stir-fry everything together over high heat for 2-3 minutes until well blended and hot. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
recipe.waste_reduction_notes: This dish prioritizes the eggs and tomatoes which are closest to their expiration date, while incorporating the requested rice and chicken. It strictly avoids dairy products (cheese and milk) to respect dietary restrictions.

evaluation.status_message: Recipe approved with caution (83% match). Missing items: Salt, Black Pepper.

recipe.recipe_name: Creamy Cheesy Tomato Chicken & Rice Skillet
instructions: Rinse the rice and cook in a small pot with 300 ml water over medium-low heat for 15 minutes until tender.
While rice cooks, heat olive oil in a deep skillet over medium-high heat.
Add diced chicken breast to the skillet and sauté for 6-8 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Add the diced tomatoes to the skillet with the chicken and cook for 2-3 minutes until soft.
In a small bowl, whisk the eggs and whole milk together.
Reduce skillet heat to low, stir in the cooked rice, and pour the egg and milk mixture over the top. Stir gently for 2 minutes until the mixture turns creamy and thickens.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese evenly over the top, cover with a lid for 2 minutes until the cheese is melted, and serve warm.
recipe.waste_reduction_notes: This recipe utilizes Whole Milk, Eggs, and Tomatoes, which are the ingredients expiring soonest in your fridge (Sept 22-23), effectively minimizing food waste while satisfying the requirement to use rice.

evaluation.status_message: Recipe approved with caution (88% match). Missing items: Salt, Black Pepper.
